title: Mailer
summary: Sends the app's email: modules queue a message (MailClient) and a background job delivers it over SMTP with retries; an outbox page shows what was sent and what failed. Development without SMTP writes email to the log.
when_to_use: Any module needs to email people: password reset, invitations, notifications, documents.
when_not_to_use: Bulk or marketing email — use a newsletter service; this sends one message per person, transactionally.
Attachments or inbound email are needed now — not in this version.

env.name: SMTP_HOST
env.description: Mail server (a transactional provider: Brevo, Mailgun, SES, Postmark, …). Empty in development: email is written to the log. Production refuses to start without it.

env.name: SMTP_USERNAME
env.description: SMTP login, if the server needs one.

env.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
env.description: SMTP password or API key — a secret.

env.name: SMTP_TLS
env.description: starttls (default), tls (port 465), or none (a local test server; refused in production).

env.name: MAIL_FROM
env.description: Sender address, on a domain with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records for the provider (e.g. noreply@tokomaju.com).
